name: bambu-printer-mcp
description: Drive Bambu Lab 3D printers from Claude -- upload and slice models, start and monitor prints, and manage AMS filament, over MQTT and FTPS on your local network.

printer_host.title: Printer IP address
printer_host.description: LAN IP address of your Bambu Lab printer.

bambu_serial.title: Printer serial number
bambu_serial.description: Serial number shown on the printer's touchscreen or in Bambu Studio device settings.

bambu_token.title: LAN access code
bambu_token.description: Access Code shown on the printer's network settings screen.

bambu_model.title: Printer model
bambu_model.description: Required for safe G-code generation. One of: p1s, p1p, p2s, x1c, x1e, a1, a1mini, h2d, h2s, h2c, x2d. X2D supports status and slicing; direct printing is not yet supported.

blender_mcp_command.title: Blender MCP executable (optional)
blender_mcp_command.description: Executable for your Blender MCP server, for example the full path to uvx. Leave empty to use printer tools without Blender.

blender_mcp_args.title: Blender MCP arguments (optional)
blender_mcp_args.description: JSON array of arguments for the executable, for example ["blender-mcp"]. Enable the matching MCP addon inside Blender before editing.

slicer_path.title: Slicer executable path (optional)
slicer_path.description: Full path to the Bambu Studio (or compatible) slicer executable, if not in the default location.
